2026_04_TEN_BAL.headline: Baltimore’s leaky defense gets a get-right opportunity against Tennessee’s struggling offense
2026_04_TEN_BAL.paragraph1: Cam Ward enters Baltimore looking to rebound from a difficult finish against New York, while Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry give the Ravens multiple ways to stress Tennessee’s defense. Robert Saleh’s group can make this competitive if Jeffery Simmons disrupts Baltimore’s reshuffled interior line and forces longer possessions. The Ravens, meanwhile, need cleaner tackling and steadier protection so Jackson is not carrying the entire burden late. Tennessee’s best path is pressure inside, disciplined run defense and efficient early-down offense.
2026_04_TEN_BAL.model_rationale: Baltimore owns more offensive answers, while Tennessee’s best counter is interior disruption, disciplined run defense and enough early-down efficiency to keep the game from becoming one-dimensional.
